summary: Re-verification of the two bug fixes from iteration_3. Both fixes are in place and working end-to-end against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Ran the 4 targeted pytest tests plus a manual curl smoke — all pass. (1) FIX-1 verified: /app/backend/server.py::_event_to_response() now includes `free_parking=doc.get('free_parking', False)` at line 262. GET /api/events?upcoming=false returns 56 events (baseline unchanged), every event contains the free_parking field, distribution = 12 True / 44 False / 0 missing — matches DB state. (2) FIX-2 verified: /app/backend/crawler_utils.py::robots_check() now validates urlparse(url).scheme AND .netloc at line 145-146 and raises ValueError('malformed URL ... missing scheme or host'). POST /api/admin/sources/robots-check with {'url':'not-a-url'} + admin auth → HTTP 400 with detail 'robots-check failed: malformed URL not-a-url: missing scheme or host'. Valid URL {'url':'https://www.mudam.com/programme'} still returns HTTP 200 with allowed=true, crawl_delay_seconds=0.0, host='https://www.mudam.com', user_agent contains 'FamilyLuxembourgBot'. Pytest results: test_events_list_has_family_fields_and_shape PASSED, test_deep_dive_seed_count_and_family_flags PASSED (deep-dive-seed has 14 events, at least one with free_parking=True), test_robots_check_invalid_url_returns_400 PASSED, test_robots_check_mudam_allowed PASSED — 4/4 in 1.23s. No regressions detected.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix quality is good: single-line addition to _event_to_response for free_parking mirrors the existing pattern for accessibility_wheelchair/sensory_friendly.

robots_check() now correctly rejects any URL where urlparse fails to produce both scheme and netloc — the ValueError message includes the offending URL for good debuggability, and the FastAPI wrapper in server.py converts it into a clean HTTP 400 with the error text propagated in `detail`.

Recommendation (unchanged from iteration_3): server.py is at 883 lines — _event_to_response's manual field-by-field mapping is the exact pattern that caused BUG-1. Long-term, switch to EventResponse.model_validate(doc) with ConfigDict(extra='ignore') and drop the ObjectId `_id` explicitly, to prevent the same class of drift when new fields are added.
